title: Kandinsky Lab Open Sources Video AI With 29B Parameter Pro Model
summary:
The creators of the Kandinsky 6.0 suite made available new tools to generate video with native synchronized audio and high-fidelity visuals. The release consists of two models, a 29B parameter Pro version for cinematic quality and a 3B parameter Lite version for fast iteration, with both the code and weights provided under an MIT license.

The model is currently available via the fal platform, which includes integrated upscaling and standalone video super-resolution tools. Additionally, the vLLM-Omni project provides day 0 inference support, allowing the system to generate 5 second video clips from text or image inputs with lip sync capabilities.
